# Zillow
> The leading real estate marketplace for buying, selling, renting, financing, and valuing homes.

Zillow helps consumers search homes for sale and rent, estimate home values with Zestimate®, explore mortgage options, and connect with real estate professionals. Its ecosystem also includes tools for agents, rental managers, and home shoppers researching local markets.

## Home Search
- [Homes for Sale](https://www.zillow.com/homes/): Search homes for sale across the United States with filters for price, beds, and property type.
- [New Construction](https://www.zillow.com/new-homes/): Browse newly built homes and communities from builders and developers.
- [Foreclosures](https://www.zillow.com/foreclosures/): Explore foreclosure and bank-owned property listings in local markets.
- [Coming Soon](https://www.zillow.com/coming-soon/): View homes expected to hit the market soon.
- [Open Houses](https://www.zillow.com/open-house/): Find homes hosting upcoming open houses near you.
- [Recently Sold Homes](https://www.zillow.com/sold/): Research recently sold properties and comparable home sale prices.
- [Off-Market Homes](https://www.zillow.com/off-market-homes/): Explore off-market properties and historical home information.

## Rentals
- [Rental Listings](https://www.zillow.com/homes/for_rent/): Search houses, apartments, and other rental listings nationwide.
- [Apartments for Rent](https://www.zillow.com/apartments/): Browse apartment communities and unit listings by city or neighborhood.
- [Houses for Rent](https://www.zillow.com/homes/for_rent/house_type/): Find single-family homes and similar rental properties.
- [Rental Manager](https://www.zillow.com/rental-manager/): Manage rental listings, applications, leases, and tenant screening tools.
- [Rental Applications](https://www.zillow.com/rental-manager/resources/rental-applications/): Learn how Zillow supports online rental applications for landlords and renters.
- [Tenant Screening](https://www.zillow.com/rental-manager/resources/tenant-screening/): Review tenant screening features and workflows for rental property managers.

## Home Values and Market Data
- [Home Values](https://www.zillow.com/home-values/): Explore home value estimates and local housing market trends.
- [Zestimate](https://www.zillow.com/z/zestimate/): Learn how Zillow's Zestimate home valuation model works and what affects estimates.
- [Housing Market Overview](https://www.zillow.com/research/data/): Access housing data, market reports, and research resources from Zillow.
- [Recently Sold Data](https://www.zillow.com/sold/): Use sold listings to compare pricing and neighborhood market activity.
- [Price History](https://www.zillow.com/how-much-is-my-home-worth/): Estimate what a home may be worth using Zillow valuation tools.

## Mortgages
- [Mortgage Rates](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-rates/): Compare current mortgage and refinance rates from lenders and marketplaces.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-calculator/): Estimate monthly mortgage payments including taxes, insurance, and HOA fees.
- [Refinance Rates](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-rates/refinance-rates/): Review current refinance rate information and lender options.
- [Affordability Calculator](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-calculator/house-affordability/): Estimate how much house you may be able to afford.
- [Amortization Calculator](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-calculator/amortization-calculator/): Calculate loan payoff schedules and principal versus interest over time.
- [Mortgage Learning Center](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-learning/): Read guides explaining mortgages, refinancing, and home financing basics.

## Buying and Selling Guides
- [Buy a Home](https://www.zillow.com/home-buying-guide/): Learn the steps involved in searching for and purchasing a home.
- [Sell a Home](https://www.zillow.com/sellers-guide/): Review guidance for preparing, pricing, and listing a home for sale.
- [How Much Is My Home Worth?](https://www.zillow.com/how-much-is-my-home-worth/): Get started estimating a home's value before selling or refinancing.
- [First-Time Home Buyer Guide](https://www.zillow.com/home-buying-guide/first-time-home-buyers/): Read practical guidance for buyers navigating their first purchase.
- [Closing Costs Guide](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-learning/closing-costs/): Understand common closing costs associated with buying a home.
- [Down Payment Guide](https://www.zillow.com/mortgage-learning/down-payment/): Learn how down payments affect affordability, loans, and monthly payments.

## Professionals and Business Tools
- [Find an Agent](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/): Search for local real estate agents and read client reviews.
- [Premier Agent](https://premieragent.zillow.com/): Zillow's platform for agents to advertise, manage leads, and grow their business.
- [Agent Resources](https://premieragent.zillow.com/agent-resources/): Access articles and materials for lead conversion, marketing, and client service.
- [Rental Manager Resources](https://www.zillow.com/rental-manager/resources/): Read operational guides for landlords and property managers.
- [Post a For Sale by Owner Listing](https://www.zillow.com/for-sale-by-owner/): Learn about listing a home directly as an owner.
- [Post a Rental Listing](https://www.zillow.com/rental-manager/post-a-listing/): Create and publish a rental listing for prospective tenants.

## Research and Data
- [Zillow Research](https://www.zillow.com/research/): Read housing market analysis, forecasts, and data-driven reports.
- [Data and Charts](https://www.zillow.com/research/data/): Browse downloadable housing data and visual market indicators.
- [Research Blog](https://www.zillow.com/research/): Follow Zillow economists and analysts covering housing trends.
- [Market Reports](https://www.zillow.com/research/topics/market-reports/): Explore recurring reports on home prices, rents, and inventory.
- [Rental Market Trends](https://www.zillow.com/research/topics/rentals/): Review research focused on rents, multifamily markets, and affordability.

## Help and Account
- [Help Center](https://zillow.zendesk.com/hc/en-us): Find support articles for accounts, listings, rentals, and technical issues.
- [Sign In](https://www.zillow.com/user/acct/login/): Access your Zillow account to save homes, searches, and applications.
- [My Zillow](https://www.zillow.com/myzillow/): Manage saved homes, saved searches, and account activity.
- [Contact Us](https://www.zillow.com/z/info/contact-us/): Find contact options and support information for Zillow services.
- [Accessibility](https://www.zillow.com/z/info/accessibility/): Review Zillow accessibility commitments and support resources.

## Company and Legal
- [About Zillow](https://www.zillow.com/z/info/about/): Learn about Zillow's mission, products, and company background.
- [Careers](https://www.zillow.com/careers/): Explore job openings and working at Zillow.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.zillow.com/corp/Privacy.htm): Review how Zillow collects, uses, and shares personal information.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.zillow.com/corp/Terms.htm): Read the terms governing use of Zillow websites and services.
- [Fair Housing Guide](https://www.zillow.com/rental-manager/resources/fair-housing-guide/): Learn about fair housing considerations for rental advertising and screening.
